device_path.description: Path to the LUKS volume (block device or header dump file)

dictionary_file.description: Path to a dictionary file (passwords one per line); if non-empty, overrides brute-force mode

beginning.description: Fixed beginning of password to prepend to generated candidates (brute-force mode)

end.description: Fixed ending of password to append to generated candidates (brute-force mode)

min_length.description: Minimum total password length including beginning and end (brute-force mode)

max_length.description: Maximum total password length including beginning and end (brute-force mode)

charset.description: Character set used to generate middle portion of passwords (brute-force mode)

threads.description: Number of parallel threads to use

report_interval.description: Seconds between automatic progress reports (0 disables automatic reports)

state_file.description: Path to state file for session persistence (resume/restore); if empty, no persistence
